If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic and fast-growing organization, we’d love for you to help us continue delivering industry-leading service to our customers. You’ll help ensure network uptime, performance, and reliability while learning the fundamentals of network operations in a fast-paced environment. Previous experience in IT, Help Desk, or Network Support preferred but not required.  PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:  Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment. review_candidates.title: Cybersecurity Implementation Engineer
review_candidates.description: Revolutional delivers advanced technology solutions and mission support to federal agencies across civilian, health, and national security environments. We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes. We are redefining how federal technology gets built and delivered by operating with a product mindset, prioritizing speed, ownership, and execution over bureaucracy. Cybersecurity Implementation Engineer Location: United States (Remote) Terms: Full-time Clearance: Public Trust Salary: $135-155k DOE Travel: 0-10% Position Description We have an exciting opportunity for a Cybersecurity Implementation Engineer to join our growing team . As a Cybersecurity Implementation Engineer, you will play a critical role in supporting the mission of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) deploying DTEX User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) tools across multiple environments. The role requires a strong understanding of both security principles and the technical intricacies of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructures. Veterans are encouraged to apply. What You'll Do As a Cybersecurity Implementation Engineer: The primary duty is to lead the end-to-end technical deployment of the DTEX platform (lightweight endpoint collectors/forwarders, management consoles, and analytics servers) across Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints. This will be done alongside DTEX Networks SMEs. The role requires the engineer to design and execute silent, scalable deployment strategies using enterprise software distribution tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Ansible) while ensuring zero degradation to host system performance. Identify and document required network paths, firewall rules, and proxy/TLS inspection exceptions for agent-to-management-server and management-server-to-cloud communication across on-prem sites, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, and SaaS/PaaS boundaries; author and submit firewall change requests through VA's change process. Coordinate with endpoint security/allowlisting teams to establish necessary application-control allowlist entries and AV/EDR exclusions (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender) so the DTEX agent installs and runs cleanly without triggering false positives. A part of the job is to implement and enforce DTEX’s "Privacy-by-Design" masking and anonymization features to ensure metadata collection complies with regulatory requirements (GDPR, HIPAA) and internal privacy guidelines. The Implementation Engineer will act as a subject matter expert for post-deployment issues. They perform fault isolation and root cause analysis to diagnose and resolve complex technical problems related to DTEX functionality, integration, or performance. This can involve troubleshooting support and providing technical assistance as needed. The role involves integrating DTEX telemetry and high-fidelity alerts with existing SOC tooling, including SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic) and SOAR platforms via REST APIs and Webhooks. Operations and Maintenance will require, monitoring endpoint agent health, performance, and fleet connectivity; lead troubleshooting of agent conflicts, missing telemetry, or local environment issues. Engineer will be required to maintain complete deployment documentation, architectural diagrams, and operational runbooks for tier-1/tier-2 support handover. Engineer will need to participate in DR tabletop exercises.
